evals.prompt: Run a full security audit on my Android app - I want to know if there are any CVEs in my dependencies and security issues in the code before I submit to the Play Store
evals.expected_output: A structured security report with dependency CVE check, manifest audit, network security analysis, data storage review, and prioritized findings table with severity ratings

evals.prompt: Check if my app has any hardcoded API keys or secrets that could be leaked, and also check if my network calls are secure
evals.expected_output: Focused findings on API key exposure (BuildConfig vs hardcoded), network security config, HTTPS usage, and certificate pinning status with specific file:line references

evals.prompt: I'm worried about the WebView in my app loading HTML study materials - is it safe? Also check my data storage for auth tokens
evals.expected_output: WebView security analysis (JS enabled, file access, SSL handling) and DataStore/token storage audit with specific recommendations for EncryptedSharedPreferences or Android KeyStore
